summary: Model Risk Management Analyst, AVP candidate with ~7 years across independent model validation, ALM and credit risk modelling, and statistical analysis. At Moody's Analytics, holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios, operating within a formal Model Governance Program — independently reviewing model assumptions, economic defensibility, and stress behaviour prior to production release. Practitioner depth in IFRS 9 transformation (EY) and stochastic scenario modelling (Ortec Finance). CFA charterholder; dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering).

sections.heading: Independent Model Validation & Governance
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to institutional client portfolios ($5-25bn per engagement; ~$50bn+ cumulative), operating within Moody's formal Model Governance framework.

Perform independent review and challenge of curve construction, spread calibration, cross-asset interactions, and stress behaviour prior to production release; produce validation reports documenting findings to standards aligned with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.

Escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; manage resolution of findings with model developers and serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Quantitative Modelling & Statistical Analysis
bullets: Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; cross-check sensitivity consistency at portfolio-level aggregates under parallel and non-parallel stress scenarios.

Led design and implementation of a multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios; embedded behavioural cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation controls, and version tracking.

sections.heading: Documentation & Stakeholder Communication
bullets: Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering model outputs, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities — translating quantitative findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences including risk committees.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and documentation — reducing development cycle time by an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated client investment-team requirements into structured Product Owner development requests; advised on asset, liability, and ALM model configurations.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 9 and IFRS 17 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients; advised actuarial, IT, finance, and PM functions on standards adoption and governance documentation.
Contributed to regulatory-readiness processes and developed advisory product offerings for IFRS 17 implementation — coordinating across finance, risk, and IT teams on milestone delivery.

Built and validated stochastic economic scenario generators using Monte Carlo and statistical methods to assess interest rate, inflation, and funding-volatility risk under base and stressed environments.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds; analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet exposures; presented findings to investment committees.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR via Ortec's GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, attribution, and near-optimal frontier robustness analysis.

Led onboarding and ALM study for the University Pension Plan merger (three single-employer plans into a new jointly-sponsored plan) — on a team of three developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics and overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
